raters.persona: You are a graduate student based at the NTU main campus (Gongguan), looking for a studio. You are moderately price-sensitive. You need room for a desk and bookshelves and hate cramped rooms. You refuse to climb more than two flights of stairs. You do not mind many housemates. You do laundry at home and need a washing machine. You tolerate a long commute for a better flat.

You are a graduate student based at the NTU main campus (Gongguan), looking for a studio. You have a comfortable allowance; rent matters little below NT$25,000. You are out all day and are fine with a small room. You do not mind walk-ups at all. You are noise-sensitive and wary of crowded subdivided flats. You cook often and need a fridge and gas or a stove. You cycle everywhere and want to be close to campus.
